Chapter 12
The Brachial Plexus and Nerves of the Upper Limb

The brachial plexus is formed by the anterior rami of spinal nerves C5 to T1. It is conventionally described as roots, trunks, divisions, cords and terminal branches. The upper trunk (C5, C6) gives rise to the suprascapular nerve; the lateral cord gives the musculocutaneous nerve and the lateral root of the median nerve.
Clinical note: Erb's palsy follows traction injury of the upper trunk.

4 Transport of Substances Through Cell Membranes

Diffusion versus active transport. Simple diffusion occurs through the lipid bilayer or protein channels; Fick's law describes the net flux. Primary active transport uses ATP directly, as in the Na+/K+ pump, which moves 3 Na+ out and 2 K+ in per cycle. Secondary active transport couples the movement of one substance to the downhill gradient of another.
Key terms: electrochemical gradient, osmosis, facilitated diffusion.

Efficacy and Safety of LDL-Lowering Therapy Among Men and Women: Meta-Analysis of Individual Data

Background: Statins reduce major vascular events, but uncertainty remains about adverse effects at high doses. Methods: We pooled data from 27 randomised trials (n = 174,149). Rate ratios per 1.0 mmol/L reduction in LDL cholesterol were estimated with stratified log-rank methods.
Results: Myopathy was rare. Hepatic enzyme elevations occurred in 0.4 %.

Acute and Chronic Inflammation: Summary

Inflammation is a protective response involving host cells, blood vessels, proteins and other mediators. The five Rs: recognition of the injurious agent, recruitment of leukocytes, removal of the agent, regulation of the response, and resolution. Cardinal signs: rubor, tumor, calor, dolor, functio laesa.
Granulomatous inflammation: a distinctive pattern of chronic inflammation in which activated macrophages form epithelioid cells.

Abstract. Carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae has spread rapidly in European hospitals. We analysed 4,812 clinical isolates collected between 2018 and 2023 and screened for bla-KPC and bla-NDM genes. Prevalence of carbapenemase producers rose from 3 % to 11 %. Infection control measures, including contact isolation, reduced transmission.

A structured medication review aims to optimise therapy and reduce drug-related problems. Step 1: collect the patient's complete medication list including OTC products. Orem's Self-Care Deficit Theory of Nursing

The theory consists of three interrelated theories: self-care, self-care deficit and nursing systems. Self-care is the practice of activities that individuals initiate and perform on their own behalf to maintain life, health and well-being. Nursing is required when therapeutic self-care demand exceeds self-care agency.
Nursing systems: wholly compensatory, partly compensatory, supportive-educative.

Using thematic analysis in psychology

Thematic analysis is a method for identifying, analysing and reporting patterns (themes) within data. We outline six phases: familiarising yourself with your data; generating initial codes; searching for themes; reviewing themes; defining and naming themes; producing the report. We argue that it should be seen as a foundational method for qualitative analysis.

Delirium in Older Hospitalised Patients

Delirium is an acute fluctuating disturbance of attention and cognition. Hypoactive forms are frequently missed. Risk factors: dementia, sensory impairment, polypharmacy, dehydration. Non-pharmacological prevention (orientation, mobilisation, sleep hygiene, glasses and hearing aids) reduces incidence by about one third. Screening tool: CAM.

Staging and grading of periodontitis: Framework and proposal of a new classification

The 2017 World Workshop introduced a multi-dimensional system. Stage I to IV describes severity and complexity of management based on clinical attachment loss, radiographic bone loss and tooth loss. Grade A to C reflects the rate of progression, with risk factors such as smoking and diabetes.

Maximal Oxygen Uptake

VO2max is the highest rate at which oxygen can be taken up and used during intense exercise. According to the Fick principle, VO2 = cardiac output x arteriovenous oxygen difference. Limiting factors include stroke volume, haemoglobin mass and mitochondrial density. Typical values: 35-40 mL/kg/min in untrained adults, above 70 in elite endurance athletes.

During the third week the primitive streak appears on the epiblast. Cells migrate through the streak and displace the hypoblast to form definitive endoderm; mesoderm forms between epiblast and endoderm. The notochord arises from cells of the primitive node and induces the neural plate.

Chapter 5: Acids and Bases

Brønsted acids donate protons, bases accept them. The strength of an acid is expressed by Ka; pKa = -log Ka. For a weak acid HA, the pH is given by pH = 1/2 (pKa - log c). Buffers resist change in pH; the Henderson-Hasselbalch equation: pH = pKa + log([A-]/[HA]).

Le débit de filtration glomérulaire (DFG) est d'environ 125 mL/min. Il dépend de la pression hydrostatique glomérulaire, de la pression oncotique et de la perméabilité capillaire. The Transformation of Europe

The legal structure of the Community was moulded by two doctrines: direct effect and supremacy. Taken together they created a constitutional order in everything but name. Yet political integration lagged behind: the Luxembourg Compromise preserved the veto, and Member States' influence shifted from voice to exit.
Sections: I. Introduction; II. The legal transformation; III. The political counterpart.

In re Caremark International Inc. Derivative Litigation

Chancery Court, 1996. Plaintiffs allege that directors breached their duty of care by failing to monitor corporate employees who violated federal health care laws. The court holds that a director's obligation includes a good faith effort to ensure that an adequate corporate information and reporting system exists. Liability requires a sustained or systematic failure of oversight.

Mens rea: a comparative note

Common law systems distinguish intention, recklessness and negligence; German doctrine knows Absicht, direkter Vorsatz and dolus eventualis. The Cunningham test of subjective recklessness resembles dolus eventualis, but the cognitive and volitional elements are weighed differently. See also the Model Penal Code, s. 2.02: purposely, knowingly, recklessly, negligently.

Access to Justice: The Worldwide Movement to Make Rights Effective

Three waves of reform can be identified. The first wave concerned legal aid for the poor; the second, representation of diffuse interests such as consumers and the environment; the third, a focus on institutions, procedures and alternative dispute resolution. Civil procedure must be seen as an instrument for realising substantive rights.

United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG)

Overview. The CISG applies to contracts of sale between parties whose places of business are in different Contracting States (Art. 1). Conformity of goods: Art. 35. Notice of lack of conformity must be given within a reasonable time (Art. 39). Remedies of the buyer: repair, replacement, avoidance, price reduction (Arts. 46-52).

Chapter 2 - Offer and Acceptance

An offer is an expression of willingness to contract on certain terms, made with the intention that it shall become binding upon acceptance. Postal rule: acceptance is complete on posting (Adams v Lindsell).

The Reception

From the twelfth century the study of Justinian's Corpus Iuris Civilis at Bologna led to the glossators and later the commentators. The ius commune, a blend of Roman and canon law, became the common legal heritage of continental Europe. Local customs remained in force but were interpreted in its light.

Proportionality as a general principle

From its roots in Prussian police law, proportionality (Verhältnismässigkeit) travelled to the European Union and many constitutional courts. The three- or four-step test: legitimate aim, suitability, necessity, and balancing in the narrow sense. Critics argue that balancing lacks a rational standard.

Direct effect means that a provision can be relied on before national courts. Conditions: the provision must be clear, precise and unconditional. Punishment and Responsibility

Abstract: What justifies punishment? The retributivist answers by reference to desert, the utilitarian by its consequences. Hart proposes a distributive principle: punishment must be limited to the guilty, though its general justifying aim may be social protection. The excuses (mistake, accident, duress) are examined as conditions of responsibility.

Introduction to Roman Law - Property and Possession

Ownership (dominium) was the most complete right over a thing; possession (possessio) was a matter of fact backed by interdicts. Modes of acquisition: mancipatio, in iure cessio, traditio, usucapio (one year for movables, two for land). Gaius, Institutes 2.40-41, discusses the distinction between quiritary and bonitary ownership.

Pure Theory of Law - Excerpt

The legal order is a hierarchy of norms. The validity of a norm derives from a higher norm; the chain ends at the basic norm (Grundnorm), which is presupposed. Kelsen is considered the intellectual father of the Austrian Constitution of 1920 and the first constitutional court.

ILO Fundamental Conventions

Eight conventions cover freedom of association and collective bargaining (No. 87, 98), the elimination of forced labour (No. 29, 105), abolition of child labour (No. 138, 182) and non-discrimination (No. 100, 111). Genesis 1: Creation

The first chapter of the Hebrew Bible opens with the formula 'In the beginning'. The text is structured in six days of creation followed by the Sabbath. Source criticism ascribes it to the Priestly writer, in contrast to the Yahwist account in Genesis 2. Terms: tohu wabohu, ruach elohim, tselem.

Paul and the Law: reconsidering justification by faith

Abstract. The so-called New Perspective on Paul claims that 'works of the law' refers primarily to boundary markers such as circumcision and food laws, not to legalistic self-righteousness. We trace the debate from Sanders to Wright and ask what remains of the Reformation reading of Romans 3-4.

The Reformation: The Wittenberg Theses

On 31 October 1517 Martin Luther sent his Ninety-Five Theses to Archbishop Albrecht of Mainz. The immediate occasion was Tetzel's preaching of indulgences. Within weeks the theses had been printed and circulated across the Holy Roman Empire. Luther's emphasis on grace alone soon turned into a wider movement.

Summary of the Doctrine of the Word of God

The Word of God occurs in a threefold form: revealed, written and proclaimed. Dogmatics is the critical test of the church's talk about God. Revelation is God's self-disclosure; it cannot be derived from human experience or natural theology.

Costly grace and responsible action

Abstract: Dietrich Bonhoeffer's Ethics is read as a theological reflection on responsibility under conditions of political tyranny. Key concepts: ultimate and penultimate, the mandates, Stellvertretung (vicarious representative action). We contrast it with Kantian and utilitarian approaches.

Interreligious Learning in Schools

Encounters with other faiths require teachers to combine factual knowledge with an attitude of respect. Approaches: Hull's three models, co-operative RE, dialogical RE. We present a classroom example in which pupils visit a mosque and a synagogue and later reflect in learning journals.

Can belief in God be rational without evidence? Plantinga argues that belief in God may be properly basic. The classical foundationalist criterion of proper basicality is self-referentially incoherent. We turn to the Aquinas/Calvin model of the sensus divinitatis.

Die Hohen Feiertage Rosch Haschana und Jom Kippur. Die drei Wallfahrtsfeste Pessach, Schawuot und Sukkot. Chanukka erinnert an die Wiedereinweihung des Tempels. Purim: Lesung der Estherrolle. Der Kalender ist lunisolar; ein Schaltmonat (Adar II) sichert den Bezug zu den Jahreszeiten.

Leiden (dukkha), Entstehung des Leidens (Verlangen, tanha), Aufhören des Leidens (nirvana) und der Edle Achtfache Pfad. Der Pfad wird in Weisheit, ethisches Verhalten und Geistesschulung gegliedert. Theravada, Mahayana und Vajrayana deuten die Lehre unterschiedlich.

Le contrat de vente (art. 184 ss CO)

La vente est un contrat par lequel le vendeur s'oblige à livrer la chose vendue à l'acheteur et à lui en transférer la propriété, moyennant un prix que l'acheteur s'engage à payer. Garantie en raison des défauts: l'acheteur doit vérifier la chose et aviser le vendeur sans délai (art. 201 CO). Actions: rédhibition, réduction du prix.

Le fédéralisme suisse

La Constitution fédérale répartit les compétences entre la Confédération et les cantons (art. 3 et 42 Cst.). Les cantons sont souverains dans la mesure où leur souveraineté n'est pas limitée par la Constitution fédérale. Principe de subsidiarité, péréquation financière, collaboration horizontale (concordats).

La capacità civile

Ai sensi dell'art. 12 CC ha l'esercizio dei diritti civili chi ha la capacità di agire. Sono capaci di agire le persone maggiorenni e capaci di discernimento (art. 13 CC). I minorenni e le persone sotto curatela generale non hanno la capacità di agire, salvo atti strettamente personali.

L'acte administratif: notion et validité

L'acte administratif unilatéral est une décision individuelle et concrète rendue par une autorité dans l'exercice de la puissance publique. Conditions de légalité: compétence, procédure, respect de la loi. L'acte illégal peut être annulé; l'acte nul est dépourvu d'effet dès l'origine.

La competenza per territorio

Il foro generale è quello del domicilio del convenuto. Fori speciali: luogo di esecuzione del contratto, luogo del fatto illecito. Il regolamento Bruxelles I bis disciplina la competenza giurisdizionale nei rapporti intraeuropei. La proroga di competenza deve risultare per iscritto.
